thread:
Alex: Quick brain fart idea: if you had to mail your future self a 3-song mixtape with one song that sums up today, one that soothes, and one that cracks you up, what are you sending? No pressure, silly answers welcome.
Maria: Ha love this. 1) Today: Sheryl Crow - Soak Up the Sun 2) Soothing: Iron & Wine - Naked as We Came 3) Laugh: Weird Al - Amish Paradise :joy:
Sam: Ooh. Mine: 1) Today: LCD Soundsystem - Someone Great 2) Soothe: Otis Redding - Try a Little Tenderness 3) Laugh: Benny Hill Theme (yes) :rofl:
Jordan: Here's mine: 1) Today: M83 - Midnight City (vibing) 2) Soothe: Nick Drake - Pink Moon 3) Laugh: The Lonely Island - Jack Sparrow :ship:
Tara: Very modern, very emo. Mine is messy: 1) Today: Dua Lipa - Levitating 2) Soothe: Sufjan Stevens - Should Have Known Better 3) Laugh: Flight of the Conchords - The Most Beautiful Girl in the Room :laughing:
Alex: Concept: write a tiny note for each song explaining why and tuck it in a shoebox. Would you actually listen later?
Maria: Maybe. Probably cry on track 2.
Sam: I would absolutely cue up the laugh track first, practicality.
Jordan: If someone compiles a playlist, tag me. I'll throw in an instrumental transition track between songs for dramatics.
Alex: @DevBot can we make a channel playlist? :)
DevBot: Created playlist "future-me-mixtape" and shared with #random. Link: https://redwood.example/playlist/future-me-mixtape :robot_face
Tara: Suggestion: add a tiny line like "Open on [date]" to each song's description. Time capsule vibes.
Maria: Love that. Let's set a soft open date 10 years from today.
Sam: Also wondering: would you send a physical CD/cassette for authenticity? who still has a cassette player?
Tara: I volunteer to make physical copies. I still have a USB cassette adapter and a stack of blank CDs. Retro flex.
Jordan: Physical mail sounds delightful. Imagine opening one in 2036.
Alex: Okay this is officially the nerdiest morale activity and I am here for it. Monthly follow-up: do we rotate themes?
Maria: Maybe every month has a prompt: emotion, decade, guilty pleasure, instrumental only. Low effort, high fun.
Sam: I'll make a reminder in my calendar to ping the channel on the first Monday of each month.
Tara: If someone wants a physical copy, add a :package: emoji in their playlist description and I'll DM for addresses.
DevBot: Reminder set: monthly mixtape ping scheduled.
Alex: Signing off as chief shoebox procurement officer. :shoe: 
Maria: (reacts :heart:)
